stories.title: Pochettino signs deal to remain USMNT manager
stories.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has signed a new contract to continue as manager of the U.S. men's national team, U.S. Soccer announced Monday morning.

stories.title: Sources: Phils trade for batting champ Arraez
stories.summary: The Phillies are acquiring three-time batting champ Luis Arraez from the Giants in a move that has the second baseman joining his fifth team in five years, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Lions' Gibbs: 'Time will tell' when hold-in ends
stories.summary: Lions running back Jahmyr Gibbs said Monday that "only time will tell" when he will return to practice as he seeks a contract extension.
